inputs.causal_hypothesis: More manufacturable AI-assisted designs may lift utilization of Stratasys systems and its installed-base materials and service revenue, but industrial qualification and competitive barriers may slow transmission.
inputs.focused_questions: Test installed base, system/material/service mix, recurring proprietary materials, aerospace, automotive, healthcare, utilization leverage, Forward AM integration, concentration, competition, margins, cash flow, balance sheet, scenarios, rating, and invalidation.

objective: Research and value Stratasys as an industrial polymer printing and materials platform.
